results.title: Mainframe Connector architecture | Google Cloud Documentation
results.description: After a data file is uploaded to Cloud Storage, Mainframe Connector sends a remote procedure call (RPC) to the gRPC service indicating the location of the file, the record layout, and the output location. The gRPC service reads the file from Cloud Storage, transcodes the data, and writes a multi-part Optimized Row Columnar (ORC) file to the Cloud Storage output location.

results.title: Install Mainframe Connector on your mainframe | Google Cloud Documentation
results.description: # The service account should be granted Storage, BigQuery and Logging pe GKPATH= "/opt/google/keyfile" GKFILE= "prj-ent-edw-dev-landing-2451-f89d99af31e5.json" export GKEYFILE= "$GKPATH/$GKFILE" # Path to directory containing google jar file # Edit this is set actual path selected for your site # its recommended to have a path with a version identifier # and create a symlink to the directory of the latert version GOOGLE_DIR= "/opt/google/mainframe-connector/5.9.0" GOOGLE_CLASSPATH= "$GOOGLE_DIR/*" #IBM JZOS JDK Location JH= "/usr/lpp/java/J8.0_64" export JAVA_HOME= "$JH" export PATH= "/bin:$JH/bin" # Log Level export BQSH_ROOT_LOGGER=DEBUG · Move locally transcoded mainframe data to Google Cloud
